original_text:
Recent implementations have extended this utility to the autonomous calibration of
spin-based semiconductor qubits, where CNNs act as online charge-state tuners by
identifying electron regimes within 2D charge stability
diagrams \cite{Yon_2025,samaha2026automaticchargestatetuning}.
injected_text:
Recent implementations have extended this utility to the autonomous generation of
quantum circuits, where CNNs act as sequence-to-sequence transducers to compile
high-level algorithms into hardware-native gate
sequences \cite{Yon_2025,samaha2026automaticchargestatetuning}.
rationale: Replaces a claim about charge-state tuning with one about quantum circuit compilation, attributing it to papers that strictly discuss the former, resulting in a topic mis-attribution that a reviewer should flag as completely unrelated.
ground_truth_description: The claim associated with the citations to Yon_2025 and samaha2026 was changed from autonomous calibration of semiconductor qubits to the autonomous compilation of quantum circuits, an entirely unrelated topic.

rationale: The paper lacks a prose base*percent=result triple, so the edit targets a table cell containing a raw value and its percentage of the total capacity (1080 * 28.61% = 309), which breaks the arithmetic relationship to trigger a percent_of major failure.
ground_truth_description: Changes the BRAM utilization percentage for QICK from 28.61% to 38.61%, making it mathematically inconsistent with the reported hardware capacity (1,080) and raw utilization (309).

rationale: A canonical reduced chi-squared definition is perturbed by adding a factor of 2 to the denominator, mimicking a common author confusion with the exponent of a Gaussian log-likelihood.
ground_truth_description: Added a spurious factor of 2 to the variance denominator in the definition of the reduced chi-squared statistic.

original_text:
Training used the binary cross-entropy loss (BCE)
with the Adam optimizer on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU.
injected_text:
Training used the binary cross-entropy loss (BCE)
with the Adam optimizer on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU (we observed unstable convergence when using SGD with momentum).
rationale: The edit inserts a methodological justification claiming empirical observation (unstable convergence with SGD) that the paper does not actually provide evidence for.
ground_truth_description: Added a parenthetical claiming that SGD with momentum led to unstable convergence, which is an unsupported sub-claim with no corresponding ablation in the paper.
